objective: Manager-compose the exact accepted Python HTTP Doctor+Branch scaffold, Upload successor, MR-list successor, and preflight-bound MR-write successor in that order using product-delta-only ports, explicit shared-dispatcher/session/response ownership, fresh composition reviews, and exact-head focused and broad gates; remain blocked until all three successor SHAs, ACCEPT reports, and the MR-write shared-primitives READY report are bound.

risk.rationale: All Python HTTP routes share one codefire dispatcher, request ledger/deadline, sealed-session and authority owners, response publication, cleanup, and reducer seams. The scaffold embeds an unaccepted Upload slice, MR-list descendants inherit it, MR-write diverges on another lineage, and isolated reviews cannot validate manager conflict resolution.

disallowed_actions: Create a dev-swarm manifest, launch a worker, or write product bytes while packet status is blocked
Replace an UNBOUND accepted SHA without an immutable exact-candidate ACCEPT report commit, report SHA-256, product tree, and patch digest
Merge, rebase, or cherry-pick an agent worktree or branch tip wholesale
Integrate 701469f or an MR-list descendant wholesale when Upload is pending, rejected, interrupted, or unavailable
Replay duplicate Upload recovery commits 3153d75 or cb13da0 already represented by 0703f71
Import product bytes from rejected candidates 38da898 or 6dd4527 without their independently accepted additive successor semantics
Port MR-write before the accepted Upload and MR-list ownership models are composed
Launch or compose an MR-write successor that did not bind the exact shared-primitives preflight READY report before implementation
Resolve shared dispatcher, response, session, authority, cleanup, nonce, or reducer conflicts outside the manager lane
Let the conflict-resolution author independently approve the same composed product tree
Treat an isolated-candidate test or review as evidence for manager-authored composition bytes
Run or integrate the Python POST GC successor under this packet
Update issue state, history, reports, task packets, manifests, recovery ledgers, Install, Dogfood, Close, Retrospect, or capability advertisement

non_goals: Implement or independently review the isolated Upload, MR-list, or MR-write repairs
Reconstruct a no-Upload Doctor/Branch/MR-list alternative when Upload is rejected
Change Rust, file transport, Python GC, packaging, devcontainer, CI, or dogfood source
Merge management, report, task, manifest, agent-state, or recovery-ledger commits as product deltas
Perform Install, Dogfood, Close, Retrospect, capability re-advertisement, or final CFR-168 issue synchronization
Invent a third weaker semantic model merely to make conflicting accepted patches apply

invariants.statement: Upload, MR-list, and MR-write enter composition only through exact immutable successor SHAs with independent ACCEPT reports, report digests, product trees, and patch digests bound into this packet.
invariants.falsification_test: Leave one accepted binding UNBOUND, substitute a REQUEST_CHANGES parent, alter one accepted product blob after review, or omit the report digest; every case must keep the packet blocked before any product write.

invariants.statement: The 701469f Doctor+Branch tree is only a scaffold because it carries old Upload commit 0703f71; it is never a wholesale integration candidate without an accepted Upload advancement.
invariants.falsification_test: Set Upload to pending or REQUEST_CHANGES and attempt to select 701469f or an MR-list descendant as the final tree; provenance validation must reject the inherited 0703f71 bytes.

invariants.statement: The only authorized product order is Doctor+Branch scaffold, accepted Upload, accepted MR-list, shared-primitives READY preflight, accepted MR-write, then final full-spine review.
invariants.falsification_test: Swap MR-list and Upload, launch or port MR-write before either predecessor or without the bound READY report, or run final review before the last conflict resolution; dependency readiness must fail.

invariants.statement: Every input is an explicit accepted product/test/source-doc delta inside the write set; no agent branch tip, report, packet, manifest, ledger, issue, or unrelated source byte enters the composition.
invariants.falsification_test: Compare the composed changed-file and commit provenance against the declared accepted ranges; add one management path or unlisted product path and require failure.

invariants.statement: Each mixed GET or POST request owns exactly one handler http_v1 ledger, one deadline, one route-appropriate session/snapshot set, one response selection, and one terminal cleanup path.
invariants.falsification_test: Instrument alternating Doctor, Branch, Upload, MR-list, and MR-write requests; any fresh request-reachable local_v1 ledger, duplicate physical object read, foreign response owner, residual scalar, permit, or second terminal observation fails.

invariants.statement: Bundle, Doctor, list, and mutation flags reset before every request; one origin-sensitive filesystem/transport taxonomy, response publication boundary, and phase dispatcher preserves every accepted route outcome.
invariants.falsification_test: Alternate GET and POST routes on one connection and inject filesystem ETIMEDOUT, actual transport timeout/reset, deadline expiry, encoding/header limits, and cleanup failure; require the exact route-specific typed or abandoned outcome without state leakage.

invariants.statement: Upload, MR-list, and MR-write reuse validated sealed snapshots and pinned authority through complete response preparation and the immediate final prepublication fence, with no post-fence input-dependent work.
invariants.falsification_test: Change content, identity, mode, link count, project descriptor, branch, MR, or generation before, during, and after digest/encoding/fence hooks; stale success, duplicate reread, or publication after change fails.

invariants.statement: Upload and MR writes share one prepublication-sealed reducer/nonce/object/escrow/recovery protocol, and cleanup retains retry ownership until every release succeeds without replacing the selected primary result.
invariants.falsification_test: Fail each first object write, later object write, nonce confirmation, reducer transition, response handoff, owner release, and second cleanup attempt; require either no effect or durable recoverability, exact retry, one response, zero debt, zero permits, and one terminal observation.

invariants.statement: Every cumulative manager conflict-resolution series and the final full spine receive a fresh independent review bound to the exact composed product tree and patch digest.
invariants.falsification_test: Reuse an isolated review, review a parent head, or change one product byte after ACCEPT; the review binding must become insufficient for integration.

invariants.statement: Focused checks follow every product/conflict commit, Python-pattern discovery follows every stable next-wave head, and unrestricted discovery plus demo follow the final MR-write composition on the exact unchanged product tree.
invariants.falsification_test: Run a gate on a parent/export with different blobs or add one product byte after a green run; the evidence must be invalidated and rerun.

invariants.statement: Python POST GC remains excluded until the independently accepted full spine exposes reusable ledger/deadline, session/response, reducer, cleanup, and terminal interfaces through a separate typed packet.
invariants.falsification_test: Add a GC product or test path, claim uniform POST nonce/publication closure, or launch GC before final spine ACCEPT; scope and predecessor checks must fail.

invariants.statement: The four canonical source documents describe the one composed dispatcher, ledger/deadline, session/snapshot, authority, response, reducer, cleanup, and GC handoff model implemented by the final tree.
invariants.falsification_test: Compare every changed owner and route symbol with all four source documents, then remove or contradict one route/owner statement and require source-doc/review failure.

validation.command: Bind ACCEPTED_UPLOAD_SHA, ACCEPTED_MR_LIST_SHA, and ACCEPTED_MR_WRITE_SHA plus each exact ACCEPT report commit/SHA-256, candidate parent/head/tree, deterministic patch digest, changed-file set, finding disposition, and the pre-implementation shared-primitives READY report commit/SHA-256 before changing status to ready.
validation.purpose: Make dependency readiness, preflight provenance, and accepted product provenance explicit before any composition write.
Reject syntax/import defects after each product-delta or conflict-resolution commit.
Exercise every composed route owner; run the directly affected subset after each delta and the complete set on the final spine.

validation.command: Run the packet's mixed GET/POST dispatcher, filesystem/transport, deadline, response, session, authority-fence, reducer, nonce, cleanup, exact-boundary, and durable-state reversal matrix on the exact composed head.
validation.purpose: Prove manual conflict resolution preserves cross-route ownership rather than only isolated focused cases.
Run the broad Python runtime group at every stable composition head used as a later base.
Run unrestricted discovery after MR-write and the final manager conflict resolution.
Exercise the repository demo on the exact final composition before composition handoff.
Keep the four canonical source documents synchronized with the composed route and owner model.
Validate links and document inventory without changing issue or lifecycle state.
Reject whitespace and patch-integrity defects after every composition commit and at handoff.

validation.command: Obtain a report-only independent ACCEPT bound to the exact final composed product head/tree and cumulative patch digest after the last manager conflict-resolution commit.
validation.purpose: Prevent isolated predecessor reviews or stale broad evidence from authorizing manager-authored composition bytes.
